001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.CsvNavigateCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.JsonNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.impl.XmlNavigateCommand;
009import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
010import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStream;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Quick start examples for StreamConverter.
019 *
020 * <p>This provides simple, runnable examples of core functionality.
021 */
022public class QuickStart {
023  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(QuickStart.class);
024
025  /**
026   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。StreamConverterの基本的な使用例を実行します。
027   *
028   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
029   */
030  public static void main(String[] args) {
031    log.info("🚀 StreamConverter Quick Start Examples");
032    log.info("========================================\n");
033
034    try {
035      // Example 1: CSV column extraction
036      csvExample();
037
038      // Example 2: JSON property extraction
039      jsonExample();
040
041      // Example 3: XML element extraction
042      xmlExample();
043
044      // Example 4: Command pipeline
045      pipelineExample();
046
047      log.info("✅ All examples completed successfully!");
048
049    } catch (Exception e) {
050      log.error("❌ Example failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
051    }
052  }
053
054  /** Example 1: CSV column extraction */
055  private static void csvExample() throws IOException {
056    log.info("📊 CSV Example");
057    log.info("===============");
058
059    String csvData = "name,age,city\nJohn,30,NYC\nJane,25,LA\n";
060
061    // Extract name column
062    IStreamCommand csvCommand = new CsvNavigateCommand("name");
063    String result = processData(csvData, csvCommand);
064
065    log.info("Input CSV:");
066    log.info(csvData);
067    log.info("Extracted 'name' column:");
068    log.info(result);
069    log.info("");
070  }
071
072  /** Example 2: JSON property extraction */
073  private static void jsonExample() throws IOException {
074    log.info("🔍 JSON Example");
075    log.info("================");
076
077    String jsonData = "{\"name\":\"John\",\"age\":30,\"city\":\"NYC\"}";
078
079    // Extract name property
080    IStreamCommand jsonCommand = new JsonNavigateCommand("name");
081    String result = processData(jsonData, jsonCommand);
082
083    log.info("Input JSON:");
084    log.info(jsonData);
085    log.info("Extracted 'name' property:");
086    log.info(result);
087    log.info("");
088  }
089
090  /** Example 3: XML element extraction */
091  private static void xmlExample() throws IOException {
092    log.info("🌲 XML Example");
093    log.info("===============");
094
095    String xmlData =
096        """
097        <?xml version="1.0"?>
098        <person>
099          <name>John</name>
100          <age>30</age>
101          <city>NYC</city>
102        </person>
103        """;
104
105    // Extract name element
106    IStreamCommand xmlCommand = new XmlNavigateCommand("person/name");
107    String result = processData(xmlData, xmlCommand);
108
109    log.info("Input XML:");
110    log.info(xmlData);
111    log.info("Extracted 'name' element:");
112    log.info(result);
113    log.info("");
114  }
115
116  /** Example 4: Command pipeline */
117  private static void pipelineExample() throws IOException {
118    log.info("🔗 Pipeline Example");
119    log.info("====================");
120
121    String csvData = "id,name,status\n1,John,active\n2,Jane,inactive\n";
122
123    // Create processing pipeline
124    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
125      new CsvNavigateCommand("name"), // Extract names
126      new SampleStreamCommand("processor") // Process names
127    };
128
129    String result = processData(csvData, pipeline);
130
131    log.info("Input CSV:");
132    log.info(csvData);
133    log.info("Pipeline result (name extraction + processing):");
134    log.info(result);
135    log.info("");
136  }
137
138  /** Helper method to process data with a single command */
139  private static String processData(String inputData, IStreamCommand command) throws IOException {
140    return processData(inputData, new IStreamCommand[] {command});
141  }
142
143  /** Helper method to process data with command pipeline */
144  private static String processData(String inputData, IStreamCommand[] commands)
145      throws IOException {
146    try (InputStream inputStream =
147            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
148        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
149
150      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
151      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
152
153      return outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
154    }
155  }
156}
